kind: prospective clarified task definitions, not repaired original-question model results
note: Question variants and changed references are separate from immutable624. Gold and eligibility must be frozen before new generation. No new model outcomes have been used. Scope/edges define graph querying tasks, not domain truth or causal effects.

items.original_question: Return node counts by label across the graph (dataset statistics).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (n) UNWIND labels(n) AS label RETURN label, count(*) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, label
items.task_question: Within the recorded RAN4 graph, report the number of nodes bearing each node label. Return label and cnt; a node with multiple labels contributes once to each of its labels. Return all labels as an unordered set.
items.reference_query: MATCH (n) UNWIND labels(n) AS label RETURN label, count(*) AS cnt

source_audit.reason: The original asks counts but the released key grades labels only. Counts are required and output order is not requested.

items.original_question: List the resolutions tied to Rel-15 TDocs (release-scoped decisions).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-15'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 15
items.task_question: List every distinct resolution identifier in the recorded RAN4 graph with a documentary reference to at least one TDoc targeting release Rel-15. Return resolutionId as an unordered set. This asks for recorded references, without asserting causation.
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release {releaseName:'Rel-15'}) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId

source_audit.reason: The original reference truncates to 15 and duplicates resolutions via multiple referenced documents. Remove hidden cap, project requested identity, and state documentary scope.

items.original_question: List the resolutions that drive changes to spec 38.133 (decisions affecting a spec).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS types, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt AS mNum ORDER BY mNum DESC, r.resolutionId LIMIT 15
items.task_question: List every distinct resolution identifier in the recorded RAN4 graph that references a TDoc linked as modifying spec 38.133. Return resolutionId as an unordered set. The links are documentary associations, without asserting that a resolution caused a change.
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber:'38.133'}) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId

source_audit.reason: The causal wording drive changes is not supported by documentary edges. Make association scope explicit and remove unspecified LIMIT15.

items.original_question: List the level-2 sections of spec 38.104 (base-station spec structure).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (s:Section {level: 2})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.104'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber LIMIT 25
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN4 graph, list all level-2 sections belonging to spec 38.104 across its stored release versions. Return sectionId, sectionNumber and sectionTitle as an unordered set; Retain the recorded sectionId rather than collapsing records to sectionNumber.
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section {level:2})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.104'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId, s.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

source_audit.reason: The original list is capped25 without stated extent and includes multiple release versions. Define all stored versions and required section records.

items.original_question: List the top 10 spec-to-spec reference pairs (inter-spec dependency map).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(sb:Spec) WHERE sa.specNumber <> sb.specNumber RETURN sa.specNumber AS fromSpec, sb.specNumber AS toSpec, count(*) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC LIMIT 10
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN4 graph, rank inter-spec reference pairs by the number of matched section reference occurrences. For each section, use its owning spec as fromSpec and its REFERENCES_SPEC target as toSpec, exclude self-spec references, and return fromSpec, toSpec and refCount. Return up to the first 10 pairs ordered by refCount descending, then fromSpec and toSpec ascending to break ties.
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sa:Spec), (a)-[:REFERENCES_SPEC]->(sb:Spec) WHERE sa.specNumber <> sb.specNumber RETURN sa.specNumber AS fromSpec, sb.specNumber AS toSpec, count(*) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, fromSpec ASC, toSpec ASC LIMIT 10

source_audit.reason: The original asks top10 pairs; the old key omits target/count roles and tie cutoff is undefined. Define directional pairs, measured count unit and deterministic cutoff.

items.original_question: List the other specs affected by Samsung's CRs (a company's cross-spec footprint).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (c:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(comp:Company) WHERE comp.companyName CONTAINS 'Samsung' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS spec ORDER BY spec LIMIT 10
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN4 graph, list all distinct spec numbers connected to Samsung-submitted CRs by AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC or AFFECTS_OM_SPEC. Samsung means a Company companyName containing Samsung. Return spec as an unordered set. This task concerns those affected-spec relations rather than each CR primary MODIFIES target.
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(comp:Company) WHERE comp.companyName CONTAINS 'Samsung' MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS spec

source_audit.reason: Other specs lacks a comparison target; make the three recorded affected-spec relations explicit and remove hidden LIMIT10.

items.original_question: Which TRs extended existing spec sections? (incremental spec impact).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType: 'ExtendSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber, s.specNumber ORDER BY tr.trNumber LIMIT 20
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN4 graph, list all distinct pairs of technical-report number and spec number linked by an impact record whose impactType is ExtendSection. Return trNumber and specNumber as an unordered set. These are recorded impact annotations rather than an independently verified history of section changes.
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType:'ExtendSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, s.specNumber AS specNumber

source_audit.reason: The original Which TRs is capped20 and the first-column key drops target-spec mapping. Define full pairs and recorded impact semantics.

items.original_question: List the top 5 most-referenced TRs (most-cited studies).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) WITH tr, count(ref) AS refCount RETURN tr.trNumber, tr.trTitle, refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, tr.trNumber LIMIT 5
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN4 graph, return the five most-referenced technical reports, counting incoming REFERENCES_TR edges from TechnicalReport nodes. Return trNumber and refCount in order of refCount descending, then trNumber ascending; return exactly five when at least five qualify.
items.reference_query: MATCH (ref:TechnicalReport)-[:REFERENCES_TR]->(tr:TechnicalReport) WITH tr, count(ref) AS refCount RETURN tr.trNumber AS trNumber, refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC, trNumber ASC LIMIT 5

source_audit.reason: Make ranked count unit and exact cutoff policy explicit. TR title is not necessary to identify the ranked reports and is excluded.

items.original_question: Show each company's resolution contributions per Work Item (technology contribution breakdown).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN wi_id, company, cnt
items.task_question: For every Work Item and company in the recorded RAN5 graph, count distinct Resolution nodes referencing at least one TDoc that is related to that Work Item and submitted by that company. Return wi_id, company and cnt for all positive groups as an unordered set. Counts describe documentary references rather than attribution of causal contribution.
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN wi.workItemCode AS wi_id, c.companyName AS company, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt

source_audit.reason: Each-company per-Work-Item mapping demands both keys and counts; remove hidden top10 and avoid causal contribution attribution.

items.original_question: Track Samsung's resolution contributions across meetings over time (contribution trend).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS num, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY num ASC RETURN meeting, cnt
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, for each meeting with at least one Resolution referencing a Samsung TDoc, return meeting and cnt, the number of distinct such Resolution nodes made at that meeting. Samsung means companyName exactly Samsung. Order by the numeric meeting index ascending, then meeting identifier ascending for ties. These counts describe recorded documentary references, without inferring causal contributions.
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Samsung'}) MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WITH m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meeting, m.meetingNumberInt AS num, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt RETURN meeting, cnt ORDER BY num ASC, meeting ASC

source_audit.reason: Original over-time counts require chronology and counts, neither is captured by unordered meeting IDs. Define numeric order and documentary role.

items.original_question: Locate the spec and section for tables numbered 6.2.x (table-number lookup).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec), (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) WHERE t.tableNumber STARTS WITH '6.2' RETURN sp.specNumber, sec.sectionId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY sp.specNumber, sec.sectionId, t.tableId LIMIT 10
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, locate every table whose tableNumber begins with the literal prefix "6.2.". Return distinct specNumber, sectionId and tableNumber records, using each table containing section and its owning spec. Include all stored release versions and return an unordered set.
items.reference_query: MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec), (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) WHERE t.tableNumber STARTS WITH '6.2.' RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber, sec.sectionId AS sectionId, t.tableNumber AS tableNumber

source_audit.reason: Original 6.2.x is under-specified and STARTS WITH6.2 could match6.20; make exact prefix6.2. explicit, remove LIMIT10, retain table-to-section mapping.

items.original_question: List the level-2 sections of TS 38.521-2 (second-level outline).
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (s:Section {level: 2})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.521-2'}) RETURN s.sectionId, s.sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle ORDER BY s.sectionNumber, s.sectionId LIMIT 25
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, list all level-2 sections belonging to spec 38.521-2 across its stored release versions. Return sectionId, sectionNumber and sectionTitle as an unordered set; Retain the recorded sectionId rather than collapsing records to sectionNumber.
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section {level:2})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.521-2'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId, s.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber, s.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle

source_audit.reason: Define full stored release scope and required section records; remove hidden LIMIT25.

items.original_question: Which five RAN5 specs have the most sections? (largest specs)
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN sp.specNumber, count(s) AS sectionCount ORDER BY sectionCount DESC LIMIT 5
items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, rank specs whose specNumber begins with 38.5 by the number of their incoming BELONGS_TO_SPEC relations from Section nodes, including stored release variants. Return specNumber and sectionCount for up to the first five, ordered by sectionCount descending then specNumber ascending.
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber, count(s) AS sectionCount ORDER BY sectionCount DESC, specNumber ASC LIMIT 5

source_audit.reason: The broad RAN5 specs wording hides prefix-filter scope; explicitly define that scope, counts and deterministic cutoff ties.

items.original_question: Are all item-level entity nodes linked to a section via definedInSection? (link-coverage check)
items.original_reference_query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest'])   AND n.granularity = 'item' WITH n, exists((n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section)) AS linked RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class,        count(n) AS total,        sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked,        round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(n), 1) AS link_pct
items.task_question: For each of RRCParameter, CapabilityItem, Procedure, PerformanceRequirement and ConformanceTest represented by granularity=item nodes in the recorded RAN5 graph, report class, total, linked and link_pct. linked counts such nodes with at least one outgoing definedInSection edge to a Section; link_pct is 100*linked/total rounded to one decimal. Return an unordered set and omit classes with no item nodes.
items.reference_query: MATCH (n) WHERE any(l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']) AND n.granularity = 'item' WITH n, exists((n)-[:definedInSection]->(:Section)) AS linked RETURN [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']][0] AS class, count(n) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN linked THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(n), 1) AS link_pct

source_audit.reason: Original yes/no question is graded by class identity. A distinct diagnostic variant explicitly requests per-class coverage quantities. Requires single audited class per item; multilabel ambiguity unresolved until source check.

items.original_question: List the study-only TRs marked NoChange (no-spec-change studies).

items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, list all distinct technical-report numbers with an impact annotation whose impactType is NoChange. Return trNumber as an unordered set. A NoChange annotation describes the recorded label rather than proof that a study had no effects.
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact {impactType:'NoChange'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber

source_audit.reason: Clarify NoChange as a recorded impact annotation; title not required and all identifiers retained.

items.task_question: In the recorded RAN5 graph, list every distinct technical-report number and impact-type pair for impact records linked to spec 38.533. Return trNumber and impactType as an unordered set. These are recorded annotations, without independently establishing causal impact.
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber:'38.533'}) RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber, imp.impactType AS impactType

source_audit.reason: Original impact-type mapping must preserve report/type roles; clarify annotation rather than causal history and eliminate identical pair duplicates.
